text:
NeonGrid is a fast-growing fintech startup building real-time payment orchestration and risk systems. We process millions of events per day and are looking for a pragmatic Java Developer who can own backend services and help scale our streaming platform.

What you'll do
- Design, build and maintain backend services in Java that handle high-throughput, low-latency payment and event flows.
- Implement and operate event-driven processing using Apache Kafka for ingestion, routing and durable event storage.
- Collaborate with product and SRE to define SLAs, improve observability, and reduce incident surface.
- Write reliable, well-tested code and participate in code reviews and architecture discussions.
- Optimize performance and throughput, troubleshoot production issues, and implement resilient retry and backpressure strategies.
- Mentor junior engineers and contribute to engineering best practices.

What we need (mandatory)
- Java
- Apache Kafka
- 4-7 years

Bonus points (preferred / good-to-have)
- Hibernate
- Docker
- Microservices

Location and work mode
Fully remote within India.
